description: Initialize Next.js 14 project with App Router, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and core application structure including the neural network graph visualization page, news feed page, and AI analysis dashboard. Set up the complete project scaffold that can be deployed to Vercel.
steps: Initialize Next.js 14 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint using create-next-app in /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/

Install core dependencies: react-force-graph-2d (for neural network visualization), d3 (for graph data manipulation), lucide-react (icons), date-fns (date formatting), @radix-ui/react-dialog @radix-ui/react-tabs @radix-ui/react-tooltip (UI primitives)
Create app/layout.tsx with dark theme layout, navigation sidebar with links to Dashboard, Network Graph, News Feed, Analysis, and Predictions pages
Create app/page.tsx as the main dashboard showing today's summary, key economic indicators, and top news clusters

Create app/network/page.tsx with an interactive force-directed graph visualization using react-force-graph-2d. Nodes represent news articles (colored by category: domestic/international/economic/political). Edges represent economic linkages between articles. Clicking a node shows article summary and predicted pathways.
Create app/news/page.tsx showing a filterable feed of summarized news articles organized by category (Indian Local, Indian National, International) with search and date filtering

Create app/analysis/page.tsx showing the AI daily analysis with economic pathway predictions from micro to macro, pathway simulation where users can select different news inputs and see predicted outcomes
Create app/predictions/page.tsx showing historical predictions, their accuracy, and current active predictions with confidence scores
Create components/NetworkGraph.tsx - client component wrapping react-force-graph-2d with proper TypeScript types, zoom/pan controls, node click handlers, legend, and category filtering
Create components/NewsCard.tsx - card component showing summarized article with source, date, category badge, economic impact score, and link to original
Create components/PathwaySimulator.tsx - interactive component where users can toggle news events on/off and see how predicted economic pathways change
Create components/DailySummary.tsx - component showing AI-generated daily economic summary with key takeaways
Create components/Sidebar.tsx - navigation sidebar component with app branding and route links
Create lib/types.ts with TypeScript interfaces: NewsArticle, EconomicNode, EconomicEdge, Pathway, Prediction, DailySummary, GraphData
Create lib/mock-data.ts with realistic mock data for development: 20+ sample news articles from Indian and international sources, graph relationships between them, sample pathways and predictions
Create public/favicon.ico and app metadata configuration for SEO
Create .env.example with placeholder values for NEWS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, and DATABASE_URL
Create README.md with project description, setup instructions, architecture overview, and deployment guide
Ensure the app builds successfully with npm run build and has no lint errors
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
All 5 pages (dashboard, network, news, analysis, predictions) render properly
Network graph visualization renders with mock data showing interconnected nodes
Clicking nodes in the graph shows article details
News feed displays categorized articles with filtering
Analysis page shows pathway simulation interface
Dark theme is applied consistently across all pages
README.md documents the project architecture and setup
verification: Run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed- && npm run build
Run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed- && npm run lint
findings: Build and lint pass cleanly. Used tailwind v3 (not v4) with eslint-config-next@14 for compatibility with Next.js 14. Tailwind config must be .js (not .ts) when package.json has type:commonjs. react-force-graph-2d requires dynamic import with ssr:false. The @typescript-eslint rules are not available with the base eslint-config-next so custom rules were not added.
